contradictions.issue: The umbrella hook asks 'Is it safe to work right now?' and answers 'Heat has an answer. Lightning has one. So does gas.' The Lightning video says the opposite stance: this page is the backup, the cabinet lights and sounder come first. The umbrella only corrects this later (l01, 1:19). Gas also contradicts the hook in tone: the Gas video's thesis is 'a quiet screen is not an answer' and the Gas Overview has no state word.
contradictions.fix: Reword h01 so no product is promised as 'the answer' to safe-to-work, for example 'Heat has a verdict. Lightning has a state. Gas has a status line.' Keep 'one place to look'.

contradictions.videos: connected-environment (u04 stage-6 card, k02) vs lightning (l04, l13)
contradictions.issue: The umbrella puts Lightning alerting radii under the chapter 'Control' (chapter bar 'Control', k02, and the on-screen team card verb 'Control'), while the Lightning video presents the same radii as configured reference distances and never as control (and must not claim they change the alarm, L10 conflict). Also the stage-6 team card prints the unscoped verb 'Control' with its only connector drawn to the Weather Station card, which contradicts k02 and k03 (Lightning and Gas control) and the narration 'Control is narrower'.
contradictions.fix: Change the team-card verbs to Watch, Decide, Act (or Set limits), or drop the connector; rename chapter 3 to 'Settings and alerts' or add 'shown as reference rings' to k02. Keep the L10 caveat out of any 'control' wording.

contradictions.videos: gas (g10, g11 text 'The newest three read Closed') vs connected-environment (k03b evidence)
contradictions.issue: Same Gas Alerts frame, two treatments. The umbrella deliberately stopped quoting the count of Closed rows (stale live value, a fourth older Closed row sits below the fold), while the Gas video narrates 'The newest three read Closed' and callouts the three Closed cells. 'Newest three' is true, but it is the live-value habit the umbrella dropped.
contradictions.fix: Align: either both avoid the count (Gas g10: 'The newest rows read Closed, with no button.') or both state it with the 'newest' qualifier.

contradictions.videos: lightning (l09 'Neither has a menu link. You open both by address.') vs gas (g07, g08) and connected-environment (g01)
contradictions.issue: Gas wallboard and phone routes are also not linked from the menu (changes#gas-wall-phone, 'Not linked from the rail'), but the Gas video and the umbrella g01 say nothing about how to reach them, and Gas parks them at chapter 0 while Lightning gives them chapter 3 with the path text 'Wallboard and phone: by address' printed after the builder's 'CLICK' prefix. A viewer of the Gas video cannot find the views it spends 15 s on.
contradictions.fix: Add the same one-clause 'opened by address, no menu link' to g07 or g08 (and to umbrella g01 caption), and treat the chapter bar the same way in both videos.

contradictions.issue: The builder prints 'CLICK <path>' on every chaptered shot, including shots where nothing is clicked and the Lightning path 'Wallboard and phone: by address', which is a URL, not a click. Guardrail 9 says click callouts are demonstrations only. Chapter-path naming is also inconsistent for the same navigation: Weather says 'Left rail > Weather Station / Reports / Settings', the umbrella says 'Left menu >' (correct, it is the app's inner menu) and 'Portal left rail >' (correct for the portal icon rail, used again in z01), Gas and Lightning say 'Connected Environment > ...'. In the Weather video 'Left rail' therefore names the wrong thing (Weather Station, Reports and Settings sit in the inner left menu, not the portal's icon rail).
contradictions.fix: Use one convention: 'Left menu' for the app menu, 'portal rail' only for the Connected Environment icon. Ask the lead for a builder prefix option (WHERE / PATH) or no prefix unless click:true.

contradictions.videos: connected-environment (p02 lane, evidence) vs lightning (l11) vs weather (w17)
contradictions.issue: Modbus treatment differs. The umbrella shows MODBUS STYLE FRAMES only on the weather lane; the Lightning lane says 'same kind of frames' and the badge omits Modbus, and the evidence note says 'Lightning's frame differs from weather's', so 'same kind' needs the reader to infer Modbus. The Lightning video says outright that Lightning frames are 'Modbus style frames'. A viewer of the umbrella would conclude only weather is Modbus.
contradictions.fix: In umbrella p02 add 'in Modbus style frames too' or make the Lightning lane badge 'SAME MESH TRANSPORT · MODBUS STYLE FRAMES'; keep the explanation sentence only in p01.

contradictions.videos: gas (g15, g16, diagram sink 'Over an hour old: Check') vs connected-environment (p03, assumptions)
contradictions.issue: Different evidence threshold for the same unknown claims. The umbrella keeps the gas cadence (about every minute / about every 30 min) out of the voice because G03 is live_today unknown, and says only vendor cloud, black box, no mesh, no Modbus. The Gas video speaks the cadence and also states plainly 'One quiet for over an hour reads Check' (G10 and G11 both live_today unknown; only an offline detector was seen live, no stale-but-reporting one). Guardrail 11: unknown means omit or soften to what the page shows.
contradictions.fix: Soften g16 to what the page shows: 'Each reading shows its age, and the page counts a reading as new only if it is under an hour old. The fifth is offline and reads Check.' (Overview tile text: 'Reading newer than 60 min'.) Keep cadence with 'about'/'typically' or move it to lane text only, as the umbrella does.

contradictions.videos: weather (w09 spotlight on the whole Select parameters dialog) vs connected-environment (w03 window) and gas (g04, beatsheet 'CO and CO2 removed')
contradictions.issue: Same gear dialog, different treatment. The umbrella crops the window so no gas row (CO2, H2S, CO) shows. The Weather video spotlights the entire dialog, which lists H2S, CO and CO2 switches, while the Gas video shows only H2S, oxygen and LEL (CO and CO2 were removed from Gas). Nothing is narrated, but a viewer of both sees H2S and CO in a weather menu and a Gas screen that says three gases.
contradictions.fix: Narrow the w09 zoom and spotlight to the first six or seven rows (as the umbrella does), or add one clause that the dialog lists weather parameters.

contradictions.videos: weather (w18) vs connected-environment (z01), gas (g17), lightning (l16 card)
contradictions.issue: Next-step lines differ on the entitlement qualifier. Umbrella, Gas and the Lightning card say 'if your project has it'; Weather w18 says 'open Weather Station' with no qualifier, although w15 in the same video says each project switches on only the products it uses (and Project B has Weather Station Inactive). Lightning l16 narration also drops the qualifier that its card carries.
contradictions.fix: Add 'if your project has it' to w18 and l16 narration.

contradictions.issue: Capture-time framing differs. Lightning says 'The state tile read All Clear when we captured this'. The umbrella o03 says in present tense 'Weather reads Danger. Lightning reads All Clear. Gas reads Check.' Labels say Project A, B, C, and every video carries the LIVE CAPTURE 4 OCT 2026 label, so this is low risk, but the careful past tense exists in only one video.
contradictions.fix: Use 'read ... when captured' in o03 (or 'show') to match the Lightning wording.

wording_inconsistencies: Gas page names: the menu item is 'Dashboard' and the page heading is 'Overview'. Gas chapter paths say '... > Gas > Dashboard' and narration says 'Overview' (g03, umbrella g02). Pick one, probably 'Overview' in voice and 'Dashboard' only in the path, and say so once.

Modbus explanation: the same sentence 'Modbus is an industrial wiring and data standard many sensors speak.' is reused verbatim in umbrella p01 and weather w17 (acceptable, each video stands alone). Lightning l11 changes the form to an appositive ('They travel in Modbus style frames, an industrial wiring and data standard many sensors speak'), which reads as if the frames are the standard. SPEC.md's own wording ('industrial wiring standard') also differs from the guardrail wording ('wiring and data standard'); all three videos use the guardrail version, good. Align l11 to the two-sentence form.

Other sentences reused verbatim across videos: 'Readiness reads Not ready.' (umbrella c02, weather w07), 'Compliance lists the limits.' (umbrella g03, gas g14), 'the vendor's cloud, a black box to us' (umbrella p03, gas g15), 'With edit access, this is where you close one' (umbrella k03b, gas g10). Acceptable repetition for the same facts; vary at least the umbrella versions if the four are watched back to back.

The page note on Gas Alerts is paraphrased two ways, neither verbatim: umbrella k03 'It is not sent to Blackline, the vendor: the alert stays open in Blackline Live' and gas g12 'Closing is recorded here, not sent to Blackline, the vendor. A closed alert stays open in Blackline Live.' Guardrail: name Blackline only when quoting the page. Use the exact page sentence ('It is not sent to Blackline: an alert closed here stays open in Blackline Live.') in both and keep 'the vendor' as a separate gloss. Caption and callout 'Not sent to Blackline' in gas are fragments of the page text and are fine.
Cadence wording for gas detectors: 'usually about every 30 min' (umbrella lane), 'typically ... about every thirty minutes' (gas g16), 'REPORT ABOUT EVERY 30 MIN' (gas badge). Use one adverb.

Lightning lane wording: umbrella 'Cloud queues' (plural), Lightning 'Cloud queue'; umbrella narration 'go to a separate queue', Lightning 'are set aside'; badges say 'WIRELESS MESH' (Lightning), 'ON-SITE MESH' (Weather), 'WIRELESS MESH . MODBUS STYLE FRAMES' (umbrella); caption p04 says 'the site mesh'. Weather lane last step is 'WakeCap' in the Weather video and 'Weather Station' in the umbrella.

Lightning distance vocabulary within one video: 'configured thresholds' (l04), 'radii' (l05, page label 'Alarm radii' vs 'Alerting radii'), 'distances' (l13), 'rings'. The umbrella adds 'alerting radii' under Control. Choose 'alert distances' (lead decision 6) for voice and keep page labels only in quotes.

How the green-only rule is attributed: umbrella l01 'In Lightning, only green counts as safe to work.' (no owner) vs Lightning l03 'WakeCap treats only the green state as safe to work.' Use the Lightning wording in both.

'New' labelling: umbrella captions use 'Recently added' on only two beats (Connected Products, alarm history); Weather uses 'New:' and 'New home'; Lightning uses 'New'; Gas says 'new' once ('the new Overview'). The chosen baseline (August answer-first dashboard) is the same in the notes but is never said on screen.

DIRECTION framing (umbrella only): diagram title 'DIRECTION: A FUTURE AI ASSISTANT', ribbon 'DIRECTION . NOT LIVE TODAY', caption badge 'DIRECTION', captions 'Direction: ...'. The voice never says 'direction' or 'not live today' (a01 says 'future', a02 'No assistant runs on any site'). a02 states what exists today but carries the DIRECTION badge. The brief and research say 'agent'; all copy says 'assistant' (the unrendered stage-7 card still says 'Future AI assistant' and 'Proposes actions', whereas the agent diagram says 'Propose' and a03 says 'propose changes'). Decide on 'assistant' deliberately and keep 'proposes changes' everywhere.

Product name forms: 'Weather' (umbrella tile labels, o03, k01 'In weather') vs 'Weather Station' (menu, cards); 'Lightning sensors' vs 'Lightning sensor' vs 'lightning warning unit' (none used, good); 'Gas detectors' consistent.

Beat ids are reused across videos with different content (w03, l01 to l03, g01 to g03 exist in both the umbrella and a product video). Harmless in the builder, confusing in review notes; prefix umbrella ids if the lead cross-references them.

Present-tense live values: Gas narrates 'Five detectors, four online' and 'Twelve' (on screen and part of the point, allowed); the umbrella avoids all of these. Fine under guardrail 10, but inconsistent.

coverage.requirement: Videos are stronger than before: story
coverage.where: hooks h01, w01, l01, g01; bookend closes z01, w18, l16, g17
coverage.note: Each video opens on a concrete question or scene and closes on one next step that echoes the hook. Umbrella has a clear three-chapter arc (one place to look, a detailed eye, control) and a cut-order list. Weak points: the umbrella is 517 words, about 223 to 226 s against a 3:30 target and has 9 beats under the 15-word floor; product videos sit at the top of their 2:30 ceiling (337, 335, 340 words, estimate 145 to 148 s) so a slower real voice will overrun; Weather's w16 recap card and Lightning's l15 repeat what the shots already said.

coverage.requirement: Videos are stronger than before: visuals
coverage.note: Positives: camera zooms with spotlight callouts on every shot beat, three-tile cross-project moment, new screens first-class. Weaknesses (mostly builder): the paths diagram is a thin left-aligned strip with a dangling chevron in all four; umbrella stage 6 leaves the lower third empty and connects only to the Weather card; Gas wallboard beat and two diagram beats are static for about 8 s and 18 s; the 'CLICK' prefix appears on non-click shots; the blurred Lightning map gives the eye nothing to land on; Weather w02, w06 and w07 reuse one frame three times; 'Held for' and the green 'Last reading was N minute(s) ago' line flash for about a second at the start of several shot scenes. A 'start already zoomed' builder option would remove most of the flashes.

overall: The four videos agree on the facts that matter: Gas close and acknowledge are recorded in WakeCap only (never told to the vendor), no Gas to Observation Manager, no gas notifications, no gas compliance numbers, Gas reads Check and 'Not confirmed safe' on stale data, Lightning is a backup with only green safe (stated as a rule), the AI assistant is DIRECTION and weather only with people approving, gas never uses Modbus or the mesh, and Modbus is explained on first use. Beatsheets match the specs word for word, vbuild --check passes on all four, no first-four-word duplicates, no banned words or dashes, no ticket ids, version numbers or flag names in customer-facing text, and Blackline appears only in k03 and g12. No outright guardrail break found. Fix before the real run, in order: (1) umbrella h01 vs the Lightning and Gas stance, (2) umbrella 'Control' verb and connector vs k02 and k03 scope, (3) soften Gas g16 and its diagram sink to what the page shows (guardrail 11), (4) mention how to reach the Gas wallboard and phone views and align chapter bar handling, (5) one navigation vocabulary (Left menu vs Left rail) and the 'CLICK' prefix, (6) narrow the Weather gear spotlight, (7) add 'Modbus style' to the umbrella Lightning lane. Process note: the updater reports are stale against the specs (umbrella says 30 beats, 497 words, 218 s; the spec has 31 beats, 517 words, about 223 to 226 s; Lightning says 15 beats, 338 words; spec has 16, 335; Gas says 343; spec has 340), and the umbrella remains about 13 to 16 s over the 3:30 target.
